units: <cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 2:2">Targ. Lev. II, 2</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Megillah 16a:7">Meg. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>מייתי מלי קוּמְצֵיה וכ׳</he> offered a handful of flour and was forgiven.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34:6">Lev. R. s. 34</cite> <he>יהיבין … בגו קָמְצֵיה</he> they put six Denars in his bent hand; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="S00637"><he>קוּמְצִין</he></cite>, <he>קוּמְצֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 41:47">Targ. Y. Gen. XLI, 47</cite>.—Meg. l. c. <he>אתא מלי ק׳ וכ׳</he> your handfuls (of offerings) have come to counteract my ten thousand talents of silver.
